scope: Frozen RR=1 source inputs for Legacy 25K Evaluation and PA phase adapters

source.provenance_limit: The files are absent from the pinned Git tree; this manifest pins their observed working-tree bytes individually.

destination.copy_mode: exact bytes with RR/RR_stats window paths preserved

hash_convention: sort POSIX selection-relative paths; for each update SHA-256 with path, NUL, raw file SHA-256 digest, NUL, decimal byte size, newline

validation.trade_schema: UTF-16LE with BOM; exactly seven headerless tab-separated fields
validation.stats_schema: UTF-16LE with BOM; exact 12-column header and one data row
validation.trade_stats_pairing: declared trade count and net profit agree exactly

observed_time_range.source_timezone: naive labels; interpreted later by named phase adapter
